label: Demo bank (REST)
notes: Made-up customers for test calls; see infra/demo-bank/server.py.

tools.name: verify_customer
tools.description: Checks the caller's card (last 4 digits) and date of birth against the bank's records. Fails when they don't match.

inputs.name: card_last4
inputs.description: Last 4 digits of the caller's card

inputs.name: date_of_birth
inputs.description: The caller's date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: get_card_balance
tools.description: The caller's outstanding balance, minimum due, due date, any late fee and available credit, in rupees.

inputs.name: card_last4
inputs.description: Last 4 digits of the caller's card

inputs.name: date_of_birth
inputs.description: The caller's date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: recent_transactions
tools.description: The caller's latest card payments (date, merchant, amount), newest first. Use it when they ask about recent spending or a payment.

inputs.name: card_last4
inputs.description: Last 4 digits of the caller's card

inputs.name: date_of_birth
inputs.description: The caller's date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: How many payments to fetch, 1 to 10 (default 5)

tools.name: raise_dispute
tools.description: Raises a dispute for a payment the caller doesn't recognise and returns a reference number.

inputs.name: card_last4
inputs.description: Last 4 digits of the caller's card

inputs.name: date_of_birth
inputs.description: The caller's date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD

inputs.name: merchant
inputs.description: The merchant name as it appears on the statement

inputs.name: date
inputs.description: The approximate date of the payment

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Answers general credit card questions from the help centre: fees, interest, minimum due, EMI, payments, statements, reward points, blocking a card.

tools.name: find_branch
tools.description: Lists Demo Bank branches in a city.
